name: Panasonic 4K Android TV — Skyworth OEM
notes: Panasonic resells Skyworth SW4H-based boards in Europe under various 4K model names. The board also ships in some Hisense and Skyworth-branded sets. This list was tested on a 55" Panasonic 4K set with firmware G0017.75WW_01_20240410. Check for com.community.oneroom before running: if present, add it to the list (see header comments). Do NOT disable com.google.android.setupwraith if it owns your saved Wi-Fi network — verify first with: adb shell dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'
